usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/nano-banana/generate with JSON body {prompt} (x402 pay) -> {jobId, status:"pending"}; then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIGN-IN-WITH-X (free) until status:"complete"
usage.outputShape: Generate call: body.jobId, body.status ("pending"). Poll call: body.status ("complete"), body.result.imageUrl (URL to generated PNG); also body.progress (0-100).
quirks: This stablestudio.dev surface uses a FLAT {prompt:"..."} body, NOT the Gemini-native {contents:[{parts:[{text}]}]} shape. The contents shape 400s with 'path:prompt expected string received undefined'.
ASYNC: the paid POST returns 200 with {jobId, status:'pending'} and does NOT contain the image. You MUST poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId}.
Job polling requires SIGN-IN-WITH-X (SIWX) auth signed by the SAME wallet that paid the generate call; a different wallet identity gets 403 Unauthorized. The poll itself is free (no payment).
Result is at body.result.imageUrl (a URL, not inline base64). For this registry surface the output is a hosted PNG URL, unlike the prior x402.orth.sh variant which returned inline base64.
Returned imageUrl is a Vercel blob link that expires after ~20 min - download immediately.
Optional generate fields: aspectRatio (1:1,2:3,3:2,3:4,4:3,4:5,5:4,9:16,16:9,21:9,1:4,1:8,4:1,8:1), imageSize (512,1K,2K,4K), thinkingLevel (minimal,high). Defaults: 1K, 1:1, minimal.
Price is dynamic ($0.045-$0.151); observed $0.07 for a default 1K request. Poll interval ~5s; completed in ~23s.
usage.guide: Text-to-image via Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Image on StableStudio. POST a flat JSON body {prompt:"your prompt"} (optional aspectRatio, imageSize 512/1K/2K/4K, thinkingLevel) to https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/nano-banana/generate, paying ~$0.045-$0.15 USDC on Base via x402 (no API key). You get back {jobId, status:"pending"} - the image is NOT in this response. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} using SIGN-IN-WITH-X auth signed by the same wallet that paid (free; ~5s intervals) until status:"complete", and read the image from body.result.imageUrl. Download the URL immediately - it is a Vercel blob link that expires in ~20 minutes.
